title: Native sequence restriction is right adjoint and inverse-limit acyclic
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$. Let $V_W$ be coefficientSequenceRestriction, the actual scalar restriction of native quotient-ring sequence modules to towers over the completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Then $V_W$ is right adjoint. If $I$ is any K-injective native sequence complex and $j:V_W I\to T$ is any quasi-isomorphism to a K-injective tower complex, then $\lim j$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Complexes are unbounded and no flatness or K-injectivity of $V_W I$ is assumed.

proof.text: The actual completed coefficient projections form a morphism from the constant completed ring sheaf to the quotient-ring sequence: the inverse-limit cone equations prove adjacent compatibility. Under the strict-system/sequence equivalence the generic restriction functor equals coefficientSequenceRestriction, by its sectionwise uniqueness: level actions, horizontal maps and morphisms have the specified formulas. Compose the generic extension/restriction adjunction with the equivalence to obtain right adjointness.

The additive sequence-to-strict-system equivalence preserves K-injective complexes. Apply limit_restricted_quasiIso to the resulting K-injective strict system and the given resolution of its restricted tower. Transport along the functor equality to obtain the required inverse-limit quasi-isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeSequenceRestriction_properties
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (W : Scheme.{u}) :
    (coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l E W).IsRightAdjoint ∧
      ∀ (I : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E W) ℤ)
        [I.IsKInjective] (T : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
        [T.IsKInjective]
        (j : ((coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l E W).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ T) [QuasiIso j],
        QuasiIso (((lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E W) ⥤ _).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).map j)
